summary: A checkpoint capture is no longer discarded when a desired, mission or document row stops naming a captured claim, as when a GitHub watch or a seat's desired state ends; only a row that newly names a captured claim still invalidates it

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or storage version change. Opening the store drops the projection tables' removal and collision triggers and reinstalls their update trigger on the new reference only; the trigger version stays 3 and the capture epoch does not move, because narrowing a fence invalidates no capture.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests unchanged. Staged protection may name a claim a projection no longer names; protection only keeps claims, so such a plan drops a subset of a fresh plan's.

compatibility.detail: The epoch is local to each store; mixed builds need nothing.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build is safe: it opens the store at trigger version 3 and adds its removal and collision triggers back.
